chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Al-Nawfali, from Al-Sakuni, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:
The one who loves that his water and his children be abundant, so let him frequent in eating the endive.

key_terms.الْهِنْدَبَاءِ: endive or sorrel (a type of leafy vegetable)

ai.seo_question: What food does the Imam recommend to increase children and sustenance?
ai.summary: Recorded in *Al-Kafi* by Shaykh al-Kulayni, this hadith from Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) links the consumption of endive (*hindaba*) to increased sustenance (*rizq*) and progeny, reflecting the Shia tradition of combining spiritual devotion with practical medicinal wisdom. The narration underscores the belief that specific dietary practices, endorsed by the Imams, serve as means (*asbab*) for attracting divine blessings and physical well-being.
